possession.method: sum of possession-sequence duration (penalty shootout excluded)

story.text: Argentina beat Croatia 3-0 in the Semi-finals of the FIFA World Cup 2022. Croatia had more of the ball (59 percent to 41 percent), and Argentina created the better chances by expected goals, or xG, a measure of chance quality (1.90 to 0.77). The goals came from Lionel Messi at 33:27 (penalty), Julián Álvarez at 38:26 and Julián Álvarez at 68:46.
